tasks.short: Report pertinent information to the proper authorities in cases of child abuse.

steps.what: Hear the child and the adults present on endangerment, neglect, or abuse.
Decide whether these cases of child endangerment require a report.
Write the report of pertinent information from the account she heard.
Judge the report holds only the neglect or abuse she heard.
Send the report of pertinent information to the proper authorities.

tasks.design: She hears the child and writes the safeguarding report herself in {DOCS}. She sends that same report by {EMAIL} only after she has judged that the pertinent information matches what she heard. Nothing is drafted for her.
tasks.previous_blocker: The account is spoken, the duty depends on what she heard, and a wrong report can harm the child.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that. She still writes and sends the report herself.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the case requires a report, and saying only what she heard.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the child and decides whether these cases require a report to the authorities.
tasks.altitude: She still hears the child and decides whether to report. Nothing is written for her.

reach.task: Record observations of a child seen in counseling
reach.learn: Which observations that counselor already recorded before she decides a report is required.

evidence.claim: Speech-to-note work times clinic notes. It does not describe a report to authorities about child endangerment, neglect, or abuse.

assumptions: The workflow boundary is her own report, from the account she hears to the send. The person who does this today is the school psychologist. She writes every word. No machine copies fields, and no step is a machine.
There is no structured-input contract. The account is spoken, and she writes the report in her own words. If a field list were imposed she would still write the report herself.
Upkeep is zero because nothing is built.
unknowns: Which authority this employer must notify, and which route that authority accepts.
research_questions: Whether that authority accepts mail for a safeguarding report.

incremental.description: No system is built, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No step is shortened. She still hears the child, writes the report, and sends it.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret test results and prepare psychological reports for teachers, administrators, and parents.

steps.what: Read the test results for the student on the testing console.
Map testing console scale, score, and age band onto norm table as score rows v1.
Judge each norm band in score rows v1 belongs to that scale and age.
File the checked score rows v1 beside the test results on the testing console.
Interpret the test results and prepare psychological reports for teachers, administrators, and parents.
Explain the checked psychological reports to teachers, administrators, and parents.

tasks.design: Today she writes the psychological report herself. Plain code on {SPREADSHEET} places each scale score and age band from the testing console ({OTHER}) against the publisher norm table and drafts score rows. She judges each norm band, a configured write files that same version, and she explains the report she wrote.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each publisher norm table uses its own scale and age band, and the interpretation is her judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: The testing console already stores scale, score, and age band, so plain code can place those fields on the norm table.
tasks.still_hard: Narrative tests, and the meaning of the report for this student.
tasks.human_edge: She interprets the results and writes the psychological report. The rows only place a score on a band.
tasks.altitude: She still writes and explains every report. Score rows are prepared for her to check. She gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Record clinical observations of a student
reach.learn: Which observations were already recorded before she interprets the test results.

evidence.claim: Session notes and test results are health data.
Placing a scale score against a publisher norm table is a table lookup. No product in this digest interprets a school psychology test.

assumptions: Today she writes the psychological report. The person on that writing, on the reading, and on the meeting is the school psychologist. The machine appears only when it drafts the score rows and when it files that same version. The workflow boundary runs from the test results she reads to the meeting where she explains the report she wrote.

Named fields are scale, score, and age band. The testing console produces them. The publisher norm table is already held as a workbook. If a test has no scale, score, or age band, she interprets inside the report step and the rows are not drafted.
Replacing a publisher norm table is work she already does. The check of each band is the review step, so steady upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether the testing console export already holds scale, score, and age band as named fields, or only a narrative, and which tests have a publisher norm table.
research_questions: Which tests this employer uses that already store scale, score, and age band.

already_counted.description: Judging each norm band sits in the review step.

incremental.description: No extra upkeep. Replacing the publisher norm table is work she already does.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a narrative test with no scale, score, or age band, so the rows are not drafted. High stays at 6 because she still writes and explains every report.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain student records, special education reports, confidential records, and behavioral data.

steps.what: Confirm with the teacher the services provided and the behavioral data for this student.
File the special education reports and the confidential records in the pupil files.
Draft service and behavior entries v1 from session log date, service, duration, and count.
Judge service and behavior entries v1 match the services provided and behavioral data.
Maintain student records including checked service and behavior entries v1 in pupil files.

tasks.design: Today she files special education reports and confidential records herself in the pupil files ({OTHER}). A configured copy reads date, service, duration, and count from the session log in {SPREADSHEET} into service and behavior entries. She judges those entries, and a second configured write stores that same version on the pupil record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Service notes were retyped because the session log and the pupil files did not share date, service, duration, and count.
tasks.enabler_now: Those four fields are already on the session log, so a configured copy can draft the entries without new code for each service.
tasks.still_hard: Prose behavior notes, and the confidential reports she still files herself.
tasks.human_edge: She confirms what the teacher saw and she decides what enters the confidential record.
tasks.altitude: She still files confidential records and checks entries before they are stored. The week loses retyping of complete entries.

reach.task: Store assessment scores for a student
reach.learn: Which scores that neuropsychologist already stored before she maintains the student record.

evidence.claim: Session notes and test results are health data.
Copying date, service, duration, and count from a session log into pupil files is configuration of named fields.

assumptions: Today she files special education reports and confidential records herself. The person on that filing and on the teacher confirmation is the school psychologist. The machine appears only when it drafts the service and behavior entries and when it stores that same version. The workflow boundary runs from the teacher confirmation to that store.

The session log is produced before this task. Named fields are date, service, duration, and count. If one is missing she retypes that session, which is the extra hours. Pupil files are not an employee record.
Behavioral entries are sensitive pupil information. That judgement is model knowledge and is separate from the health-data rule on test results.
unknowns: Whether the session log already stores date, service, duration, and count as named fields, and which services are logged that way.
research_questions: Which services this employer already logs with date, service, duration, and count.

already_counted.description: Judging the entries against the teacher confirmation sits in the review step.

incremental.description: Retyping a session when date, service, duration, or count is missing. The review does not cover an absent entry.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is 6 when many session logs lack date, service, duration, or count and she retypes them. High stays at 18 because she still files every confidential report herself.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile and interpret students test results to diagnose conditions and assess eligibility.

steps.what: Hear teachers and parents on students, along with the learning and behavior those adults describe.
Read the written information from teachers and parents.
Compile students test results against the eligibility threshold for that scale as threshold comparison v1.
Judge threshold comparison v1 puts each result against the threshold for that scale.
File checked threshold comparison v1 beside test results in the pupil files.
Interpret results, diagnose conditions, and assess eligibility for special services.

tasks.design: She meets teachers and parents, then reads their notes in {DOCS}. Plain code compares each test result with the eligibility threshold for that scale in {SPREADSHEET} and drafts a threshold comparison. She judges that each result sits against the threshold for that same scale, a configured write files that same version beside the test results ({OTHER}), and she still diagnoses conditions and assesses eligibility herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Eligibility thresholds differ by scale, and the diagnosis cannot be a lookup.
tasks.enabler_now: Where the criteria already name a scale and a threshold, plain code can draft the comparison for her to read.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the condition and whether the student is eligible.
tasks.human_edge: She meets the teachers and parents and she assesses eligibility. The comparison does not decide.
tasks.altitude: She still meets teachers and parents and decides eligibility. The comparison is prepared for her to read and does not decide.

reach.learn: Which findings were already recorded before she assesses eligibility.

evidence.claim: Special-needs eligibility may touch AI Act area 3, and those duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Session notes and test results are health data.

assumptions: Today she diagnoses conditions and assesses eligibility. The person on the meeting, on the notes, and on that diagnosis is the school psychologist. The machine appears only when it drafts the threshold comparison and when it files that same version. This task ends when she has written the eligibility note. Filing that note onto the student record is a different task.

Published eligibility criteria are held before this task. Named fields are scale and threshold. The producer is those published criteria. If a service has no numeric threshold, she compares by hand inside the diagnosis.
The diagnosis is not filed by a machine in this task. Updating a threshold when the published criteria change is the extra hour. The review of the comparison is already in the review step.
unknowns: Whether eligibility thresholds are published as scale and threshold fields this employer holds, and which special services use a published numeric threshold.
research_questions: Which special services at this employer use a published numeric threshold.

already_counted.description: Judging each result against its scale threshold sits in the review step.

incremental.description: Updating a threshold when the published criteria change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is 0 when the service has no published numeric threshold and she compares by hand. High stays at 9 because she still meets the adults and writes the eligibility note.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still decides the safeguarding report, the psychological interpretation, and eligibility. Service entries and score comparisons are filed only after she has checked them.
reach: From a clinical and counseling psychologist, learn which observations that counselor already recorded before she diagnoses a student or decides a report is required.
skills_to_grow: Judging a safeguarding report before it goes to the authorities
Reading a threshold comparison without letting it decide eligibility.
role.ambitious_version: She still meets the child and the parents. Score rows and service entries are prepared for her to check. She still decides what is reported and who is eligible.
